title: Filter Waiting on you by type
about: Umer can show only one type of question at a time.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Add a type filter above Waiting on you.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: A hidden type can hide a new question.

decisions.question: Show every type when the board opens?
decisions.why: A remembered filter can hide a new question.

options.label: Last filter
options.outcome: The board opens as Umer left it.
